name: Researcher Phase Transition → GATHER
description: ADR-041 Slice 2D-3 forward/back-edge spawn rule. Fires when phasevalidator.PhaseValidator has approved a transition to the gather phase (any allowed source — plan forward, synthesize back-edge, architect back-edge) and stamped chain.phase_transition.proceed.gather="true" on the source researcher loop entity. The validator has already checked the edge against the allowed-set AND the per-phase cap (max 3 gather fires per chain); rule fires only when both gates pass. Two-step fire shape mirrors the recoverycounter→rule_02 pattern: triggering loop's terminal triples land first, validator wakes on the same agent.complete and writes the proceed sentinel, the loop's entity_watcher re-evaluates, this rule's condition now passes, fires.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-gather
on_enter.prompt: GATHER phase entry. Source loop $entity.instance has handed off with decide(action="gather"). Call read_loop_result on that loop to read the upstream phase's narrative terminal (plan's scope + verifiable outcomes, or synthesize/architect's back-edge reason naming a corpus gap). Then iterate discovery: summarize_graph for type inventory → query_by_type on the plan's actor names → query_entity / query_entities to verify specific IDs. Use web_search for facts unlikely to be in the local graph (e.g. protocol specifics, external framework details). Accumulate findings in scratchpad per researcher-gather/20-iteration-rules.md. Terminate with decide(action="synthesize", reason="<one-sentence summary of evidence accumulated>") when the upstream questions are covered, OR decide(action="needs_clarification", reason="<why the plan's question is unanswerable>") when the corpus structurally cannot resolve a plan-required question.

metadata.proceed_sentinel: chain.phase_transition.proceed.gather on source researcher loop entity. Absence-of-sentinel blocks the rule fire fail-safe.
metadata.phase_cap: Per-phase cap = 3 (ADR-041 §Per-phase cap). Validator enforces; this rule trusts the sentinel.
metadata.discovery_tools_note: Smoke #26 (2026-05-14) finding: GATHER's original allowed_tools = [read_loop_result, query_entity, query_entities, scratchpad, decide] gave the LLM NO discovery-by-name primitive. Plan supplies actor names but no entity IDs; query_entity/query_entities both require known IDs. Both gather loops in smoke #26 bailed to scratchpad-only with 'no specific entity IDs to query' and emitted decide(synthesize) without evidence — synthesize then produced a 794-byte fabricated artifact. Adding summarize_graph (type inventory) + query_by_type (filter by type) + web_search (external facts) restores the discovery surface the persona was already promising. Tension with [[feedback_fewer_rich_tools]]: discovery IS gather's named job; right-sizing the toolchain for a role's documented work is different from per-role tool inflation. See project_synthesize_thinness.md. Structural pin: test/contract/adr041_persona_dirs_test.go:TestADR041_GatherDiscoveryTools.
metadata.smoke_27_success_criterion: A healthy first-pass gather loop emits >=3 query_by_type / query_entities / web_search tool calls before its terminal decide(synthesize). <3 query calls on a clean smoke run suggests the persona workflow isn't grounding and warrants persona-side rework — NOT toolchain re-narrowing. The diagnosis flip: smoke #26 was toolchain-starvation (tools missing); if smoke #27 shows <3 calls with the tools present, that's persona-workflow-not-landing, a different fix.
